name: Wall Sit, Shallow
setup: Back flat against a wall, slide down only a little, feet a step out.
cues: Slide down the wall to the depth you own and hold still.
Press the floor away evenly through both feet.
Breathe smoothly through the hold.

faults.fix: Push the knees out over your laces.
Breathe in through the nose, out long, the hold unchanged.

name: Band Terminal Knee Extension
setup: A band anchored low in front, looped behind one knee; step back until it pulls.
cues: Push the band back until the knee is straight, heel heavy on the floor.
Hold the straight knee for a beat.
Return slow on a three-count.

faults.fix: Push the knees out over your laces.
Breathe in through the nose, out long, the hold unchanged.

name: Slant Board Squat
setup: Heels on a plate or wedge, toes on the floor, feet hip-width.
cues: Sit straight down between the heels on a slow three-count.
Let the knees travel forward over the laces.
Push the floor away to stand.

faults.fix: Push the knees out over your laces.
Breathe in through the nose, out long, the hold unchanged.

name: Reverse Nordic, Short Range
setup: Kneel tall on a mat, the body in one line from knees to head.
cues: Lean back toward the wall behind you a short way as one straight piece.
Pause, then come back up tall.
Stay in one line to the wall: no folding at the hips.

faults.fix: Push the knees out over your laces.
Breathe in through the nose, out long, the hold unchanged.

name: Isometric Split Squat Hold
setup: Split stance, back knee hovering a few inches above the floor.
cues: Hold still with the back knee hovering above the floor.
